timing_definitions.processing_s: RGB-D read + SAM + DINO + all-CAD comparison + original ISM refinement + RLE; excludes image/file writes and model/reference setup
timing_definitions.output_s: RGB, depth, mask, overlay and detection files written for this case
timing_definitions.case_s: processing_s + output_s; excludes suite report generation and model/reference setup
timing_definitions.semantic_comparison_s: Exclusive DINO semantic metric and aggregation for one CAD over all valid proposals; SAM and DINO extraction shared by all CADs
timing_definitions.comparison_scores: All-CAD DINO similarities on the SAME primary proposal; only the assigned CAD receives appearance and geometry refinement as in SAM-6D
timing_definitions.zero_comparison_time: No valid proposal; CAD comparison was not performed
timing_definitions.synchronization: CUDA synchronized before and after each timer; perf_counter wall time
timing_definitions.first_case: No discarded warmup; first case can include cold initialization costs
